title: 2 Laoag cops sacked after being caught counterflowing

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Two police officers in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte, are facing administrative action after being caught counterflowing, an act recorded on video by a passing motorist and condemned by the Ilocos Norte Police Provincial Office (INPPO). Police Col. Joemar Labiano, INPPO director, said in a statement that counterflowing by police officers would not be tolerated, stressing that police force members should set an example by obeying traffic rules and regulations. READ: Jeepney operator in Quezon City counterflow summoned The two officers were initially identified during monitoring and were issued traffic tickets.
